infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow SDlove to access your camera to verify your identity for safe Christian connections, share video teachings, participate in live prayer sessions, and enable faith-based video dating with accountability features. We respect your modesty and values in all media interactions.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: SDlove requests photo access to share faith-based content including scripture images, church event photos, and profile pictures that reflect Christian values. All shared photos are moderated for appropriate content.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Allow SDlove to save prayer journals, Bible study materials, and faith-inspired artwork to your library. We will never modify or access other photos without your permission.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Used to connect you with nearby believers for Bible studies, church events, and accountable dating. Your exact location is never shared publicly - only approximate distances to maintain safety.
